ESV.1: The word of the LORD came to me:
ESV.2: “And you, O son of man, thus says the Lord GOD to the land of Israel: An end! The end has come upon the four corners of the land.
ESV.3: Now the end is upon you, and I will send my anger upon you; I will judge you according to your ways, and I will punish you for all your abominations.
ESV.4: And my eye will not spare you, nor will I have pity, but I will punish you for your ways, while your abominations are in your midst. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
ESV.5: “Thus says the Lord GOD: Disaster after disaster!  Behold, it comes.
ESV.6: An end has come; the end has come; it has awakened against you. Behold, it comes.
ESV.7: Your doom  has come to you, O inhabitant of the land. The time has come; the day is near, a day of tumult, and not of joyful shouting on the mountains.
ESV.8: Now I will soon pour out my wrath upon you, and spend my anger against you, and judge you according to your ways, and I will punish you for all your abominations.
ESV.9: And my eye will not spare, nor will I have pity. I will punish you according to your ways, while your abominations are in your midst. Then you will know that I am the LORD, who strikes.
ESV.10: “Behold, the day! Behold, it comes! Your doom has come; the rod has blossomed; pride has budded.
ESV.11: Violence has grown up into a rod of wickedness. None of them shall remain, nor their abundance, nor their wealth; neither shall there be preeminence among them.
ESV.12: The time has come; the day has arrived. Let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn, for wrath is upon all their multitude.
ESV.13: For the seller shall not return to what he has sold, while they live. For the vision concerns all their multitude; it shall not turn back; and because of his iniquity, none can maintain his life.
ESV.14: “They have blown the trumpet and made everything ready, but none goes to battle, for my wrath is upon all their multitude.
ESV.15: The sword is without; pestilence and famine are within. He who is in the field dies by the sword, and him who is in the city famine and pestilence devour.
ESV.16: And if any survivors escape, they will be on the mountains, like doves of the valleys, all of them moaning, each one over his iniquity.
ESV.17: All hands are feeble, and all knees turn to water.
ESV.18: They put on sackcloth, and horror covers them. Shame is on all faces, and baldness on all their heads.
ESV.19: They cast their silver into the streets, and their gold is like an unclean thing. Their silver and gold are not able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the LORD. They cannot satisfy their hunger or fill their stomachs with it. For it was the stumbling block of their iniquity.
ESV.20: His beautiful ornament they used for pride, and they made their abominable images and their detestable things of it. Therefore I make it an unclean thing to them.
ESV.21: And I will give it into the hands of foreigners for prey, and to the wicked of the earth for spoil, and they shall profane it.
ESV.22: I will turn my face from them, and they shall profane my treasured  place. Robbers shall enter and profane it.
ESV.23: “Forge a chain!  For the land is full of bloody crimes and the city is full of violence.
ESV.24: I will bring the worst of the nations to take possession of their houses. I will put an end to the pride of the strong, and their holy places  shall be profaned.
ESV.25: When anguish comes, they will seek peace, but there shall be none.
ESV.26: Disaster comes upon disaster; rumor follows rumor. They seek a vision from the prophet, while the law  perishes from the priest and counsel from the elders.
ESV.27: The king mourns, the prince is wrapped in despair, and the hands of the people of the land are paralyzed by terror. According to their way I will do to them, and according to their judgments I will judge them, and they shall know that I am the LORD.”

NASB.1: Moreover, the word of the LORD came to me saying,
NASB.2: 'And you, son of man, thus says the Lord GOD to the land of Israel, 'An end! The end is coming on the four corners of the land.
NASB.3: 'Now the end is upon you, and I will send My anger against you; I will judge you according to your ways and bring all your abominations upon you.
NASB.4: 'For My eye will have no pity on you, nor will I spare [you], but I will bring your ways upon you, and your abominations will be among you; then you will know that I am the LORD!'
NASB.5: 'Thus says the Lord GOD, 'A disaster, unique disaster, behold it is coming!
NASB.6: 'An end is coming; the end has come! It has awakened against you; behold, it has come!
NASB.7: 'Your doom has come to you, O inhabitant of the land. The time has come, the day is near-- tumult rather than joyful shouting on the mountains.
NASB.8: 'Now I will shortly pour out My wrath on you and spend My anger against you; judge you according to your ways and bring on you all your abominations.
NASB.9: 'My eye will show no pity nor will I spare. I will repay you according to your ways, while your abominations are in your midst; then you will know that I, the LORD, do the smiting.
NASB.10: 'Behold, the day! Behold, it is coming! [Your] doom has gone forth; the rod has budded, arrogance has blossomed.
NASB.11: 'Violence has grown into a rod of wickedness. None of them [shall remain], none of their people, none of their wealth, nor anything eminent among them.
NASB.12: 'The time has come, the day has arrived. Let not the buyer rejoice nor the seller mourn; for wrath is against all their multitude.
NASB.13: 'Indeed, the seller will not regain what he sold as long as they [both] live; for the vision regarding all their multitude will not be averted, nor will any of them maintain his life by his iniquity.
NASB.14: 'They have blown the trumpet and made everything ready, but no one is going to the battle, for My wrath is against all their multitude.
NASB.15: 'The sword is outside and the plague and the famine are within. He who is in the field will die by the sword; famine and the plague will also consume those in the city.
NASB.16: 'Even when their survivors escape, they will be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them mourning, each over his own iniquity.
NASB.17: 'All hands will hang limp and all knees will become [like] water.
NASB.18: 'They will gird themselves with sackcloth and shuddering will overwhelm them; and shame [will be] on all faces and baldness on all their heads.
NASB.19: 'They will fling their silver into the streets and their gold will become an abhorrent thing; their silver and their gold will not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the LORD. They cannot satisfy their appetite nor can they fill their stomachs, for their iniquity has become an occasion of stumbling.
NASB.20: 'They transformed the beauty of His ornaments into pride, and they made the images of their abominations [and] their detestable things with it; therefore I will make it an abhorrent thing to them.
NASB.21: 'I will give it into the hands of the foreigners as plunder and to the wicked of the earth as spoil, and they will profane it.
NASB.22: 'I will also turn My face from them, and they will profane My secret place; then robbers will enter and profane it.
NASB.23: 'Make the chain, for the land is full of bloody crimes and the city is full of violence.
NASB.24: 'Therefore, I will bring the worst of the nations, and they will possess their houses. I will also make the pride of the strong ones cease, and their holy places will be profaned.
NASB.25: 'When anguish comes, they will seek peace, but there will be none.
NASB.26: 'Disaster will come upon disaster and rumor will be [added] to rumor; then they will seek a vision from a prophet, but the law will be lost from the priest and counsel from the elders.
NASB.27: 'The king will mourn, the prince will be clothed with horror, and the hands of the people of the land will tremble. According to their conduct I will deal with them, and by their judgments I will judge them. And they will know that I am the LORD.''

NKJV.14: ‘They have blown the trumpet and made everyone ready, But no one goes to battle; For My wrath is on all their multitude.

NKJV.20: ‘As for the beauty of his ornaments, He set it in majesty;  But they made from it The images of their abominations— Their detestable things; Therefore I have made it Like refuse to them.
NKJV.21: I will give it as plunder Into the hands of strangers, And to the wicked of the earth as spoil; And they shall defile it.
NKJV.22: I will turn My face from them, And they will defile My secret place; For robbers shall enter it and defile it.
NKJV.23: ‘Make a chain, For the land is filled with crimes of blood, And the city is full of violence.
NKJV.24: Therefore I will bring the worst of the Gentiles, And they will possess their houses; I will cause the pomp of the strong to cease, And their holy places shall be defiled.
NKJV.25: Destruction comes; They will seek peace, but there shall be none.
NKJV.26: Disaster will come upon disaster, And rumor will be upon rumor.  Then they will seek a vision from a prophet; But the law will perish from the priest, And counsel from the elders.
NKJV.27: ‘The king will mourn, The prince will be clothed with desolation, And the hands of the common people will tremble. I will do to them according to their way, And according to what they deserve I will judge them; Then they shall know that I am the LORD!’ ”

NLT.1: Then this message came to me from the LORD:
NLT.2:
“Son of man, this is what the Sovereign LORD says to Israel: “The end is here!
Wherever you look —
east, west, north, or south —
your land is finished.
NLT.3:
No hope remains,
for I will unleash my anger against you.
I will call you to account
for all your detestable sins.
NLT.4:
I will turn my eyes away and show no pity.
I will repay you for all your detestable sins.
Then you will know that I am the LORD.
NLT.5:
“This is what the Sovereign LORD says:
Disaster after disaster
is coming your way!
NLT.6:
The end has come.
It has finally arrived.
Your final doom is waiting!
NLT.7:
O people of Israel, the day of your destruction is dawning.
The time has come; the day of trouble is near.
Shouts of anguish will be heard on the mountains,
not shouts of joy.
NLT.8:
Soon I will pour out my fury on you
and unleash my anger against you.
I will call you to account
for all your detestable sins.
NLT.9:
I will turn my eyes away and show no pity.
I will repay you for all your detestable sins.
Then you will know that it is I, the LORD,
who is striking the blow.
NLT.10:
“The day of judgment is here;
your destruction awaits!
The people’s wickedness and pride
have blossomed to full flower.
NLT.11:
Their violence has grown into a rod
that will beat them for their wickedness.
None of these proud and wicked people will survive.
All their wealth and prestige will be swept away.
NLT.12:
Yes, the time has come;
the day is here!
Buyers should not rejoice over bargains,
nor sellers grieve over losses,
for all of them will fall
under my terrible anger.
NLT.13:
Even if the merchants survive,
they will never return to their business.
For what God has said applies to everyone —
it will not be changed!
Not one person whose life is twisted by sin
will ever recover.
NLT.14:
“The trumpet calls Israel’s army to mobilize,
but no one listens,
for my fury is against them all.
NLT.15:
There is war outside the city
and disease and famine within.
Those outside the city walls
will be killed by enemy swords.
Those inside the city
will die of famine and disease.
NLT.16:
The survivors who escape to the mountains
will moan like doves, weeping for their sins.
NLT.17:
Their hands will hang limp,
their knees will be weak as water.
NLT.18:
They will dress themselves in burlap;
horror and shame will cover them.
They will shave their heads
in sorrow and remorse.
NLT.19:
“They will throw their money in the streets,
tossing it out like worthless trash.
Their silver and gold won’t save them
on that day of the LORD’s anger.
It will neither satisfy nor feed them,
for their greed can only trip them up.
NLT.20:
They were proud of their beautiful jewelry
and used it to make detestable idols and vile images.
Therefore, I will make all their wealth
disgusting to them.
NLT.21:
I will give it as plunder to foreigners,
to the most wicked of nations,
and they will defile it.
NLT.22:
I will turn my eyes from them
as these robbers invade and defile my treasured land.
NLT.23:
“Prepare chains for my people,
for the land is bloodied by terrible crimes.
Jerusalem is filled with violence.
NLT.24:
I will bring the most ruthless of nations
to occupy their homes.
I will break down their proud fortresses
and defile their sanctuaries.
NLT.25:
Terror and trembling will overcome my people.
They will look for peace but not find it.
NLT.26:
Calamity will follow calamity;
rumor will follow rumor.
They will look in vain
for a vision from the prophets.
They will receive no teaching from the priests
and no counsel from the leaders.
NLT.27:
The king and the prince will stand helpless,
weeping in despair,
and the people’s hands
will tremble with fear.
I will bring on them
the evil they have done to others,
and they will receive the punishment
they so richly deserve.
Then they will know that I am the LORD.”

AMP.1: Moreover, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
AMP.2: "Also, son of man, thus says the Lord GOD to the land of Israel, 'An end! The end is coming on the four corners of the land.
AMP.3: Now the end is upon you, and I will send My anger against you and will judge you in accordance with your ways and I will bring [retribution for] all your abominations upon you.
AMP.4: For My eye will have no pity on you, nor will I spare you, but I will repay you for your evil ways, while your abominations are among you; and you will know (recognize, understand) [without any doubt] that I am the LORD.'
AMP.5: "Thus says the Lord GOD, 'A disaster is coming, [one so destructive and injurious, so sudden and violent, that it stands alone,] a unique disaster, look it is coming!
AMP.6: An end is coming; the end has come! It has awakened against you. Look, it has come!
AMP.7: Your doom has come to you, O inhabitant of the land; the time has come, the day is near—tumult rather than joyful shouting on the mountains.

and their holy places shall be profaned.
NRSVCE.25:
When anguish comes, they will seek peace,
but there shall be none.
NRSVCE.26:
Disaster comes upon disaster,
rumor follows rumor;
they shall keep seeking a vision from the prophet;
instruction shall perish from the priest,
and counsel from the elders.
NRSVCE.27:
The king shall mourn,
the prince shall be wrapped in despair,
and the hands of the people of the land shall tremble.
According to their way I will deal with them;
according to their own judgments I will judge them.
And they shall know that I am the LORD.
